biggest_catch: BrandBacker is a brand-facing influencer platform whose official homepage publishes marketing stats only — no creator pay terms, rates, or payout mechanics are published.
catches: The official brandbacker.com homepage is written for brands: 'Engage and grow your brand's audience through original content from thousands of Influencers and Creators.'
The page lists marketing stats (50,000+ influencers, 2B+ followers) but no creator pay schedule, commission rates, or payout timing.
No concrete creator pay figure appears in official public terms.
Rejected on the same bar as Insense, Trend, AspireIQ, Creator.co, and Tribe: no concrete official creator rate.

c1.evidence: BrandBacker is a real company on the official brandbacker.com domain, but it is brand-facing.

c2.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure or payout mechanic in official public pages.

eligibility: Creators join brand campaigns at the brand's discretion; no public creator pay terms.
notes: The official brandbacker.com homepage was loaded live on 2026-09-22: it is a brand-facing marketing page with aggregate stats and no creator pay terms. Nothing concrete exists to verify.
